name: bandit.phase4_structural_signal_matrix_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live smoke/light/sound matrix on one production-owned structural sortie. An idle five-member camp autonomously dispatches its exact pair toward a fixture-known road target. The passive player remains 60 map squares west; scenario setup places one real active explosive and one physical fire on the target at the loaded-bubble edge shortly before the pair reaches its hourly observation point. Production must retain three typed route facts and create three returned_report leads only after physical return.

steps.label: post_load_phase4_structural_signal_matrix_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the copied night fixture reaches normal gameplay; this is startup footing only
steps.failure_rule: If gameplay does not load, no signal-matrix proof can be credited.

steps.abort_reason: fixture did not contain the exact idle five-member camp and sole road lead
steps.expected_immediate_state: five ready members and one non-signal road lead are idle before production dispatch

steps.expected_visible_fact: six real hours accumulate production terrain opportunities without fixture-injected readiness
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded wait does not complete, later signal evidence is not creditable.

evidence_contract.claim: one autonomous abstract scout pair reads physical smoke, light, and a semantic explosion only along its committed route, retains typed facts without creating camp knowledge early, and creates three bounded returned_report leads only after physical return
evidence_contract.setup_boundary: passive debug-cloaked player relocation, the known road lead, one physical fire, and one real SPAWN_ACTIVE explosive are fixture/scenario footing; no typed observation, signal lead, camp report, observer route position, or return is injected
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load/setup proof only / inconclusive for the structural signal matrix
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 matrix credit unless exact dispatch, bubble-edge source/abstract receiver observations, off-cadence semantic sound recording, pre-return no-lead state, physical return, and three exact persisted returned-report leads are separately green.
